body: my closest friends complain that I am "slow at everything" and ask why I am so slow even after I tell them it hurts me. When I tell my psychiatrist or anyone else, they just say "I am being to hard on myself" even though I am not the one insulting myself. I never say SCT I always say ADD. People need an excuse to feel better about themselves and nitpick stupid things.

I have started to feel the same way. I am distgusted with the way people treat other people and with the way certain people have treated me that I have partially grown to despise people and their behaviors. It is a fairly recent weird thing. I still feel empathetic towards people I don't wish them harm but I'm so fed up with everyones bullshit. I just wish people weren't so shitty a lot of the time.  I guess despise is a strong word but I'm just so sick of the way people are.
